description: Fetch numeric BGP visibility, active IPv4 /24 probing, or Merit telescope series for one entity in an explicit Unix-second window of at most 31 days. source is required: bgp, ping-slash24, or merit-nt. Nulls are missing observations, not zero connectivity. maxPoints requests upstream aggregation, not first-N samples; smaller values lose temporal resolution. Returned series retain aligned boundary buckets with exclusive returned until bounds that may extend beyond requested bounds; timestamps and intervals support cross-source comparisons.

entityCode.description: Two-letter country code, IODA numeric region code, decimal ASN (AS prefix accepted), or geoasn code joining an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities and pass a returned code here.

entityType.description: country, region, asn, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country); whitespace and case are normalized.

from.description: Requested start Unix seconds UTC; window at most 31 days. Aligned returned buckets may begin earlier.

maxPoints.description: Upstream aggregation target, not a local sample cap; smaller targets lose temporal resolution. Values above 2000 are served as 2000 with a notice.

source.description: Exactly bgp, ping-slash24, or merit-nt; case and whitespace normalized. gtr and ucsd-nt are not supported numeric sources.

until.description: Requested end Unix seconds UTC, after from and no later than now. Returned bucket bounds are exclusive and may extend beyond this requested bound due to alignment.

name: ioda_get_signals

applied.description: Every normalized input, effective window, filter and pagination value.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_entity`: entityCode is incompatible with entityType, zero or out of range. `invalid_window`: Reversed, future, millisecond, or over-31-day window. `upstream_bad_request`: IODA rejects the request with an error envelope or an HTTP 400 other than a missing entity. `upstream_unprocessable`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 422. `entity_not_found`: IODA has no metadata entity for a country, region, or geoasn code (HTTP 400), or returns HTTP 404. IODA synthesizes metadata for any ASN, so an unknown ASN returns no series instead. `upstream_rate_limited`: IODA returns HTTP 429. `upstream_queue_full`: The shared request queue is full. `upstream_schema`: IODA data or bucket metadata does not validate. `response_too_large`: The upstream body or combined response exceeds its byte budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Result interpretation and concrete next call.

endpoint.description: Fixed HTTPS IODA upstream endpoint URL

semantics.description: Source-specific measurement semantics and IODA unit.

unit.description: IODA's published unit for this source's values. Coarse buckets aggregate underlying samples in the same unit; values need not equal an unweighted mean of finer returned buckets, and non-null aggregates do not prove complete finer-resolution coverage.

series.description: All numeric subtypes and buckets, preserving nulls and aligned bounds.

items.description: Numeric source buckets, including missing observations

from.description: First aggregate bucket anchor, Unix seconds UTC; alignment can place it before the requested from

until.description: Exclusive returned bucket bound, Unix seconds UTC; alignment can place it after the requested until

values.description: All numeric or missing upstream aggregate values; a non-null coarse value can conceal missing finer observations

truncated.description: A full page may have further records; not an exact total.
